content.text: {"quote_faithful":"yes","verdict":"confirmed","evidence_kind":"missing_justification","fatal":"yes","explanation":"The quote is verbatim and refers to the same two uncancelled arrays discussed immediately afterward. If their totals add to T-d and each is at most (T-d)/2, both must equal (T-d)/2; the write-up gives no argument for this strong conclusion. More importantly, “arrays” and “column-blocks” are not defined sufficiently to apply the induction, and the proof never explains how cuts recursively made in an uncancelled array induce legal splits of the original columns while respecting the cut count. No later passage repairs these gaps. Since lemma (i) is the sole justification of Xiang’s all-n upper bound, that obligation remains unproved as written."}
